    "text": {
      "content_type": "text/html", 
      "value": "'<p class=\"discreet\">\\nIf you\\'re seeing this instead of the web site you were expecting, the owner of\\nthis web site has just installed Plone. Do not contact the Plone Team or the\\nPlone mailing lists about this.\\n</p>\\n\\n<h2>Get started</h2>\\n\\n<p>\\nBefore you start exploring your newly created Plone site, please do the following:\\n</p>\\n\\n<ol>\\n    <li>Make sure you are logged in as an admin/manager user.\\n        <span class=\"discreet\">(You should have a Site Setup entry in the menu in the top right corner)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@mail-controlpanel\">Set up your mail server</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Plone needs a valid SMTP server to verify users and send out password reminders)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@security-controlpanel\">Decide what security level you want on your site</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Allow self registration, password policies, etc)</span></li>\\n</ol>\\n\\n<h2>Get comfortable</h2>\\n\\n<p>After that, we suggest you do one or more of the following:</p>\\n\\n<ul>\\n    <li>Find out <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/products/plone/features/\" target=\"_blank\">What\\'s new in Plone</a>.</li>\\n    <li>Read the <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation\" target=\"_blank\">documentation</a>, especially the\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation/phc_topic_area?topic=Basic+Use\" target=\"_blank\">Documentation for content editors</a>\\n        and\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/docume..."
    }, 
    "title": {
      "content_type": "text/plain", 
      "value": "Welcome to Plone"
    }
  },

    "text": {
      "content_type": "text/html", 
      "value": "'<p class=\"discreet\">\\nIf you\\'re seeing this instead of the web site you were expecting, the owner of\\nthis web site has just installed Plone. Do not contact the Plone Team or the\\nPlone mailing lists about this.\\n</p>\\n\\n<h2>Get started</h2>\\n\\n<p>\\nBefore you start exploring your newly created Plone site, please do the following:\\n</p>\\n\\n<ol>\\n    <li>Make sure you are logged in as an admin/manager user.\\n        <span class=\"discreet\">(You should have a Site Setup entry in the menu in the top right corner)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@mail-controlpanel\">Set up your mail server</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Plone needs a valid SMTP server to verify users and send out password reminders)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@security-controlpanel\">Decide what security level you want on your site</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Allow self registration, password policies, etc)</span></li>\\n</ol>\\n\\n<h2>Get comfortable</h2>\\n\\n<p>After that, we suggest you do one or more of the following:</p>\\n\\n<ul>\\n    <li>Find out <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/products/plone/features/\" target=\"_blank\">What\\'s new in Plone</a>.</li>\\n    <li>Read the <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation\" target=\"_blank\">documentation</a>, especially the\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation/phc_topic_area?topic=Basic+Use\" target=\"_blank\">Documentation for content editors</a>\\n        and\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/docume..."
    }, 
    "title": {
      "content_type": "text/plain", 
      "value": "Welcome to Plone"
    }
  },

    },

      "value": "'<p><strong>Administrator</strong> - Robert Tratar</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>BMK</strong> - ?</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>BOR</strong> - Eva Ruzi\\xc4\\x87 Sablji\\xc4\\x87</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>CEL</strong> - Jasmina Livk</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>EMI</strong> - Mateja Polj\\xc5\\xa1ak Prijatelj</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>GLI</strong> - Tadeja Matos ; Rok Tomazin</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>HIV</strong> - Kristina Fujs ; Mario Poljak</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>HUM</strong> - Sa\\xc5\\xa1a Sim\\xc4\\x8di\\xc4\\x8d</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>KLM </strong>- Darja Ke\\xc5\\xa1e</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>MBM</strong> - Tja\\xc5\\xa1a Cerar Ki\\xc5\\xa1ek</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>PRZ</strong> - Miha Skvar\\xc4\\x8d</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>VIN</strong> - Tanja Kozinc ; Tina Ur\\xc5\\xa1i\\xc4\\x8d ; Miroslav Petrovec</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>WHO</strong> - Mi\\xc5\\xa1a Korva ; Katja Stra\\xc5\\xa1ek Smrdel ; Tatjana Av\\xc5\\xa1i\\xc4\\x8d \\xc5\\xbdupanc</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>Nazivi preiskav</strong> - Miroslav Petrovec</p>\\r\\n<p><strong>Embala\\xc5\\xbea (fotografije)</strong> - Tanja Elezovi\\xc4\\x87</p>'"

    "vzorci_odvzem": {
      "content_type": "text/plain", 
      "value": [
        "Aspiriramo vsebino iz spodnjih dihal pri intubiranem bolniku.", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "Odvzem s punkcijo iz hrbteničnega kanala (odvzame zdravnik), pred punkcijo kožo razkužimo.", 
        "Ustrezno razkužimo odvzemno mesto; odvzamemo s punkcijo perkutano.", 
        "S kirurškim posegom odvzamemo košček tkiva, damo v transportno gojišče.", 
        "Odvzem ob nadzoru medicinske sestre: bolnik si s krtačko umije zobe, usta spere z vodo, če ima zobno protezo, jo odstrani; globoko se izkašlja v sterilno posodico; najboljši je jutranji sputum.", 
        "Bolnik si pred inhaliranjem umije zobe in z vodo izpere usta, s pomočjo inhalatorja inhalira ~25 ml 3-10% sterilne NaCl, kašlja naj vsakih 5 min.", 
        "Jezik potisnemo z lopatko navzdol; z dakronskim brisom obrišemo tonzile.", 
        "Jezik potisnemo z lopatko navzdol; z dakronskim brisom postrgamo celice s tonzil in vnetih predelov."
      ]
    },

      "value": [
        "Aspiriramo vsebino iz spodnjih dihal pri intubiranem bolniku.",

        "S kirurškim posegom odvzamemo košček tkiva, damo v transportno gojišče.", 
        "Odvzem ob nadzoru medicinske sestre: bolnik si s krtačko umije zobe, usta spere z vodo, če ima zobno protezo, jo odstrani; globoko se izkašlja v sterilno posodico; najboljši je jutranji sputum.",

    "vzorci_odvzem": {
      "content_type": "text/plain", 
      "value": [
        "Aspiriramo vsebino iz spodnjih dihal pri intubiranem bolniku.", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "Bronhoskopsko spiranje predela pljuč; izvede izkušen bronhoskopist po veljavnih standardnih postopkih.", 
        "Odvzem ob nadzoru medicinske sestre: bolnik si s krtačko umije zobe, usta spere z vodo, če ima zobno protezo, jo odstrani; globoko se izkašlja v sterilno posodico; najboljši je jutranji sputum.", 
        "Bolnik si pred inhaliranjem umije zobe in z vodo izpere usta, s pomočjo inhalatorja inhalira ~25 ml 3-10% sterilne NaCl, kašlja naj vsakih 5 min.",

    "text": {
      "content_type": "text/html", 
      "value": "'<p class=\"discreet\">\\nIf you\\'re seeing this instead of the web site you were expecting, the owner of\\nthis web site has just installed Plone. Do not contact the Plone Team or the\\nPlone mailing lists about this.\\n</p>\\n\\n<h2>Get started</h2>\\n\\n<p>\\nBefore you start exploring your newly created Plone site, please do the following:\\n</p>\\n\\n<ol>\\n    <li>Make sure you are logged in as an admin/manager user.\\n        <span class=\"discreet\">(You should have a Site Setup entry in the menu in the top right corner)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@mail-controlpanel\">Set up your mail server</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Plone needs a valid SMTP server to verify users and send out password reminders)</span></li>\\n    <li><a href=\"@@security-controlpanel\">Decide what security level you want on your site</a>. <span class=\"discreet\">(Allow self registration, password policies, etc)</span></li>\\n</ol>\\n\\n<h2>Get comfortable</h2>\\n\\n<p>After that, we suggest you do one or more of the following:</p>\\n\\n<ul>\\n    <li>Find out <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/products/plone/features/\" target=\"_blank\">What\\'s new in Plone</a>.</li>\\n    <li>Read the <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation\" target=\"_blank\">documentation</a>, especially the\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/documentation/phc_topic_area?topic=Basic+Use\" target=\"_blank\">Documentation for content editors</a>\\n        and\\n        <a class=\"link-plain\" href=\"http://plone.org/docume..."
    }, 
    "title": {
      "content_type": "text/plain", 
      "value": "Welcome to Plone"
    }
  },
